about.text: The raw fresh butter of Morocco (zebda beldiya), churned from rayeb, raw milk left to sour for one to three days in an earthen jar or goatskin bag; the liquid left behind is lben. Salted and fermented, it becomes smen.

links.name: Benkirane et al., J. Microbiology, Biotechnology and Food Sciences (2022)

sources.text: Its names and facts, from these.

facts.v: There it is the fat that churning rayeb separates, churned for about 40 minutes in a chekwa, with water sometimes added to help; traditional butter should be eaten within a few days
